name: Edroz QR Payments
author: Edroz Design

sections.description:
Edroz QR Payments adds a manual Yape payment method to WooCommerce. Customers can see the configured payment details, scan a QR code, copy the payment number, and optionally provide their transaction number with the order.

Features include:

  • Visual payment method configuration.
  • QR code selected from the WordPress Media Library.
  • Button to copy the configured mobile number.
  • Link to call or add the number to contacts.
  • Exact order amount shown during checkout.
  • Optional transaction number field.
  • Option to require the transaction number.
  • Configurable initial order status.
  • Restrictions by shipping method and virtual orders.
  • Compatibility with the classic WooCommerce checkout.
  • Integration with WooCommerce Checkout Blocks.
  • Legacy Yape fields are preserved for easier migrations.

This is the free Yape edition and it works without a license or an external service.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or later.
  • WooCommerce installed and active.
  • PHP 7.4 or later.

Configuration

The Yape settings allow you to configure the title, description, account holder, mobile number, company, document number, QR code, copy/contact buttons, transaction number, instructions, and initial order status.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the plugin ZIP file and activate it.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  5. Open Yape and configure the number, account holder, QR code, and the options you want to use.
  6. Save the settings and place a test order.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account or a license?

No. The free edition works without an account or license.

Does it work with the WooCommerce Checkout Block?

Yes. The plugin includes integration with WooCommerce Checkout Blocks.

Does the plugin process payments automatically?

No. Yape is a manual payment method. The customer makes the payment in Yape and the store verifies the payment before processing the order.

Can I register the transaction number?

Yes. The field can be optional or required.

Does the plugin send data to an external server?

No. The free edition does not use a license server or make external requests to operate.
